stem.text: The double-slit experiment demonstrates interference between two coherent sources of light waves. In the diagram, the curved lines represent wavefronts.

stem.alt: Diagram of a single slit, then a double slit, with curved wavefronts spreading out from each. Points A, B, C and D are marked with leader lines; labels single slit and double slit are printed.

stem.text: At which point does complete destructive interference (a minimum) occur?
